question: Where can I find a kebab restaurant inside a 140 kilometers distance limit from Heavenly Heart Farm & Mini Petting Zoo, Edinburg, VA?
sql: SELECT poi_name, addr_city, addr_state FROM pois WHERE amenity = 'restaurant' AND cuisine ILIKE '%kebab%' AND ST_DWithin( geometry :: geography, ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Heavenly Heart Farm & Mini Petting Zoo%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Edinburg%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%VA%' LIMIT 1 ) :: geography, 140 * 1000 );

answers.description: Live music. "Ageless charm without yuppie bastardization." Established 1947. Happy hour Fr 18:00-20:00.
